summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of 10,916 new ordinary shares of 5 pence each under its scrip dividend alternative for the 2026 first interim dividend of 8.88 US cents per share, announced 27 August 2026, with a record date of 11 September 2026 and a 149-share minimum holding. Up to 4,148 shares may be sold via the share dealing facility for UK holders. The board intends to neutralize minor dilution via on-market buybacks on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine dividend mechanics notice, not a special situation. Watch only for admission timing and buyback execution.
